auth.status: production: Basic and bearer-token sessions both live on narcis.gov.si as of 2026-05-28 (deployed to ARSO prod via APEX SQL Workshop; smoke test 7/7 incl. mint, Bearer CRUD, logout revoke, revoked-token 401)
auth.server_gate: TERENSKA-BELEZNICA function via pkg_narcis_authorization; re-checked per call on both Basic and Bearer paths
auth.session_persistence: bearer token persisted in flutter_secure_storage (key narcis_auth_token) and restored on app start (AuthService.readStoredSession) - sticky session across cold starts including OS-killed background processes; app shows a splash while restoring instead of flashing the login screen

bearer_token.server_stores: SHA-256 hash only (RAW(32) PK); plaintext token returned once at mint, never persisted server-side
bearer_token.mint: pkg_tb_auth.mint_token on successful login; 32 CSPRNG bytes via DBMS_CRYPTO -> 64-hex token
bearer_token.expiry: sliding - renewed on use (throttled to <=1/24h via autonomous txn); server 401 is authoritative
bearer_token.identity: not snapshotted - email/app_user/org + TERENSKA-BELEZNICA re-derived from narcis_uporabniki per call
bearer_token.revoke: logout endpoint (pkg_tb_auth.revoke_token) or operator UPDATE tb_auth_tokens SET revoked_at; revoked/expired token -> 401
bearer_token.dependency: DBMS_CRYPTO EXECUTE on the NARCIS schema (PLS-00201 at deploy if missing)

offline_cache.purpose: offline MANUAL login only (the bearer token covers persistent online sessions)

sync_session.credential: bearer token (AppState._sessionToken) preferred; in-memory plaintext password (_sessionPassword) only as fallback when the backend did not mint a token
sync_session.implication: after a cold-start token restore canSync is true, so queued records sync as soon as connectivity returns without manual re-login; an offline-only login (no token) still queues until the next online login

tables.name: TB_SIF_MOTNJE_TIPI

tables.name: TB_MOTNJE
tables.purpose: main records; PK = client-generated UUID for idempotent POST retries; ORG_ID stamped from narcis_uporabniki.organizacija; OBHOD_ID nullable FK to TB_OBHODI (ON DELETE SET NULL) added 2026-04-27

tables.name: TB_MOTNJE_TIPI_DOGODKA
tables.purpose: junction (record × selected types); intentionally not FK to codebook so historical records survive codebook changes

tables.name: TB_MOTNJE_OPAZOVALCI
tables.purpose: junction (record × observers); free-text name + nullable FK to narcis_uporabniki

tables.name: TB_MOTNJE_FOTO
tables.purpose: photo BLOBs; PK = client-generated UUID for idempotent POST retries; SECUREFILE storage with ENABLE STORAGE IN ROW; ON DELETE CASCADE from TB_MOTNJE. (COMPRESS LOW + DEDUPLICATE removed because Advanced Compression option not licensed on this DB - ORA-00439.)

disturbance_schema.photos_status: deployed and smoke-tested 2026-04-26; 17/17 lifecycle probes passed (upload/duplicate/download/delete/404). Known cosmetic: response Content-Type on photo GET always reports image/jpeg regardless of stored MIME (WPG_DOCLOAD overrides the :content_type bind) — non-blocking until non-JPEG photos enter the pipeline

walks_schema.status: deployed and smoke-tested 2026-04-27; tables and ALTER applied; 14/14 walks lifecycle probes passed against production
walks_schema.purpose: Tracks walk-around (obhod) sessions: a continuous GPS path with linked disturbances. Walks themselves do not carry photos; photos still hang off TB_MOTNJE.
walks_schema.deploy_dependency: walks_schema.sql must run after disturbance_schema.sql (ALTER TB_MOTNJE ADD OBHOD_ID); walks_endpoints.sql can deploy independently of disturbance_endpoints.sql

tables.name: TB_OBHODI
tables.purpose: main walk row; PK = client-generated UUID for idempotent POST retries; ZACETEK/KONEC are immutable on the server (PUT only allows NAZIV + OPIS); ORG_ID stamped from narcis_uporabniki.organizacija

tables.name: TB_OBHODI_TOCKE
tables.purpose: track points; composite PK (OBHOD_ID, SEQ) where SEQ is a 0-based monotonic integer assigned by the client; ON DELETE CASCADE from TB_OBHODI; bulk-inserted via FORALL

walks_schema.fk_to_disturbances: TB_MOTNJE.OBHOD_ID is a nullable FK to TB_OBHODI(OBHOD_ID) with ON DELETE SET NULL — deleting a walk preserves its captured disturbances, just unlinks them
walks_schema.wire_ordering_constraint: client must POST a walk before any disturbance referencing it (FK on disturbance INSERT raises ORA-02291 → 500 if walk is missing); syncAll drains pending walks before pending disturbances

auth_token_schema.status: deployed to ARSO prod 2026-05-28 via APEX SQL Workshop (NARCIS schema); package PKG_TB_AUTH compiled clean (DBMS_CRYPTO grant already in place); 7/7 token-lifecycle smoke-test passed against narcis.gov.si
auth_token_schema.purpose: Bearer-token sessions: persistent login + sync without re-sending the password on every call. Primary CRUD credential going forward; Basic still accepted in parallel.
auth_token_schema.deploy_dependency: auth_token_schema.sql must run before disturbance_auth_pkg.sql (package body reads TB_AUTH_TOKENS); auth_login.sql after the package (calls mint_token/revoke_token). Requires DBMS_CRYPTO EXECUTE on the NARCIS schema (PLS-00201 at deploy if missing).

tables.name: TB_AUTH_TOKENS
tables.purpose: session tokens; PK TOKEN_HASH RAW(32) = SHA-256 of the token (plaintext never stored server-side); USER_ID FK to narcis_uporabniki ON DELETE CASCADE; CREATED_AT/EXPIRES_AT/LAST_USED_AT/REVOKED_AT/DEVICE_INFO; 30-day sliding expiry
